title: First engagements under King Oliver; uniforms in Kansas City
summary: The band was booked for the year, got two sets of uniforms made in Kansas City, and its first gig was Sioux City, Iowa in April or May 1932.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: We went out and played one gig before we left, before he sent us out on the bookings. See, he had us booked. He had booked the band up for the year, and he had us booked. So we played one gig, and then our first gig was in Sioux City, Iowa. But he sent us to Kansas City to have some uniforms made. See, we went to Kansas City and had two sets of uniforms made -- about two sets of uniforms. That was in 1932, must have been in April, the latter part of April or May.
Not only his name, but he was also in the band.
Yeah. He didn't play with us until it was his band.
Did you ever go out on the road before King Oliver got with you under his name?
